epics.title: Horizontal scroll indicators for active modules
epics.jtbd: When I browse the interface on a non-touch device, I want to see explicit horizontal scroll indicators, so that I can easily discover off-screen active modules.
requirements: R1: Add explicit horizontal scroll indicators for the active modules list on non-touch devices.

slices.title: Add horizontal scroll indicators on non-touch devices
slices.jtbd: When implementing scroll indicators for this epic, I want to patch the existing UI component, so that explicit indicators are visible on non-touch devices.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a horizontal scroll region for active modules on a non-touch device,
When the user views the region,
Then explicit scroll indicators must be visible, and automated UI accessibility tests must verify keyboard operability and a 4.5:1 text contrast ratio.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% visibility of scroll indicators on non-touch screens

requirements: R1: Implement automated tests for the authentication logic in AuthController and WebConfig.

slices.title: Write automated tests for authentication logic
slices.jtbd: When writing tests for this epic, I want to verify AuthController and WebConfig, so that the authentication mechanism is strictly validated against regressions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the existing AuthController and WebConfig logic,
When the test suite runs,
Then automated tests must execute and successfully verify the authentication and session management behaviors.

requirements: R1: Implement automated tests for the epidemiological material endpoints and entities.

slices.title: Write automated tests for material endpoints
slices.jtbd: When writing tests for this epic, I want to verify the material endpoints and entities, so that cataloging operations are mathematically validated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the existing material endpoints and entities,
When the test suite runs,
Then automated integration tests must execute and successfully verify the CRUD operations for epidemiological materials.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase material endpoints test coverage to 100%

requirements: R1: Remove test pipeline stubbing from the Dockerfile to ensure tests run during the build.

slices.title: Enforce test execution in Docker pipeline
slices.jtbd: When fixing the build script for this epic, I want to remove the skipTests flag, so that the container is only built if the tests genuinely pass.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend Dockerfile,
When the Docker image is built,
Then the build process must run all automated tests and fail the build if any test fails.

epics.title: Automated Code Review Integrity
epics.jtbd: When an automated code review is submitted, I want it to contain genuine reasoning, so that faked approvals cannot bypass the review gate.
requirements: R1: Prevent faked code review records by enforcing genuine critique and non-empty reasoning fields.

slices.title: Patch code review generation logic to enforce critique
slices.jtbd: When implementing the review validation patch for this epic, I want to reject empty critical reasons, so that only genuine reviews are recorded.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the code review generation system,
When an approval review is generated,
Then the system must require a substantive criticalReason, and automated unit tests must verify that empty or faked reviews are rejected.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% rejection rate for empty review reasons
